title: Fluxion simulation topology export (v1)
description: Deterministic thermal-network topology document emitted by `fluxion topology export` / `fluxion export-topology` (Issue #3963). Nodes are thermal-network elements; edges are heat-transfer couplings. Node and edge arrays are sorted by stable ids so identical model inputs yield byte-identical JSON.

model_name.description: Name of the exported model (e.g. 'ASHRAE 140 Case 600').

timestamp.description: Optional export timestamp. Absent by default so exports are deterministic; set explicitly when reproducibility is not required.

node_count.description: Number of nodes in the document.

edge_count.description: Number of edges in the document.

node.description: A thermal-network node. Numeric attributes are absent (not null) when not applicable to the node kind.

id.description: Stable unique node id (e.g. 'zone-0:air'). Nodes are sorted by this id.

zone_id.description: Owning zone air node id, when the node belongs to a zone.

azimuth_deg.description: Surface azimuth, degrees clockwise from North; absent for flat or ground-coupled surfaces.

tilt_deg.description: Surface tilt from horizontal (90 = vertical wall, 0 = upward roof, 180 = downward floor).

attributes.description: Extensible numeric attributes (HVAC setpoints, layer material properties, ground flags...). Keys are deterministic (sorted).

edge.description: A heat-transfer coupling between two nodes. Edges are sorted by (source_id, target_id, coupling_type).

source_id.description: Source node id; must resolve to a node in the document.

target_id.description: Target node id; must resolve to a node in the document.

conductance_w_per_k.description: Coupling conductance (W/K); absent for non-conductive couplings (solar admission, unresisted radiation star edges).

fraction.description: Coupling fraction (e.g. SHGC, gain split fraction); absent when not applicable.

bidirectional.description: Whether heat flow is modeled in both directions.

attributes.description: Extensible numeric attributes (ACH, schedule hours, window areas...).
